picks.what: Reggio and the Strait of Messina, painting (Tate, London)

picks.what: The waterfront seen from the sea, wood engraving in Le Cento Città d’Italia
picks.why: the seafront before the 1908 earthquake; 46 years after the Lear painting

picks.file: Reggio Calabria dalla collina di Pentimele.jpg
picks.what: The city and the strait from the hill of Pentimele, photograph
picks.why: general view of the city along the coast; hazy but the best modern option

gaps: P0, P2, P3: no candidates. P5: only a dark, damaged 1924 stereo negative (#5).
notes: #1: the Commons date field says ‘1500’, which is impossible for Bruegel; the date comes from his 1552 journey through southern Italy, when the drawing is generally linked to the Turkish burning of Reggio. Drop it if a firm museum date can’t be confirmed. #3 is a smaller, cropped scan of the same waterfront view as #2. P6 is hazy; replace if a better modern photo is found.
